body:
## Need
The front-end code fails to compile (build), so no change to the task panel or settings can be saved. It looks like part of the 0.1.6 font-size work was lost when it was merged into 0.2.0. This blocks the clickable link in task:b011ee47eb6a6d35.

**Wanted:** the front end builds again, and the font-size setting works as task:dad739a761baa5f0 describes (whole page scales, per D-262).

## For the agent
Found by the work run on task:b011ee47eb6a6d35 (its notes 6 and 7):
- `solace-cli/components`: `solace_task.model_select` uses `keyed.element` but doesn't import `lustre/element/keyed`.
- `solace-cli/settings`: `settings.gleam` uses `int` without importing `gleam/int`, and refers to a `SetFontSize` message that doesn't exist.
- `solace-cli/frontend` depends on settings, so it can't build until settings compiles.

Restore what the merge lost; don't redesign the font-size setting. Ask the human before changing any wording or controls.

Done when: `check` passes in all three projects, the existing settings and components tests pass, and the font-size setting behaves as task:dad739a761baa5f0 describes.
title: frontend: repair the broken build
